long_biography.plain_text:
At J. Goldman & Co., Jay G Goldman oversees an investment business built around company research and trading. The firm's equity-focused approach combines analysis of businesses with attention to market dynamics. It assesses risk at the level of individual ideas, portfolios and the firm as a whole, with capital directed towards the team's strongest investment ideas.

Goldman's university service has included more than two decades chairing Penn's alumni interview programme in Nassau County. He also served on the School of Social Policy & Practice's overseer board. A client of Penn's Ryan Veterinary Hospital, he took a particular interest in veterinary research on cancer and neurology.
